item.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't
item.description: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

item.description: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

item.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
item.description: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

item.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
item.description: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

item.title: Hegseth's failed impeachment was a warning to Democrats. Where will they go from here?
